An '''unnamed island''' in the [[Orange Islands]] appears in ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]''. It is presumably the deserted island located between [[Rind Island]] and [[Pummelo Island]] shown on the [[Media:Orange.jpg|map]] in ''[[Extreme Pokémon: The Guide for the Ultimate Fan]]'', as it has a picture of a {{p|Poliwag}} next to it.

It is the place where {{an|Misty}} [[Caught Pokémon|caught]] her [[Misty's Politoed|Poliwag]].

While the island is not home to any humans, there are cabins located on the island for Trainers to camp in. Most of the island is forest. There is a lake which is home to the {{p|Poliwag}} where [[Salveyo weed]] grows. There is also a field of flowers located on this island where {{p|Vileplume}} can be seen.
